title: Standard Error Translator
summary: Reproduce SPSS's Std. Error of the mean with a function of your own, ignoring missing values the way SPSS does.
hints: A function body can be one line: `se_mean <- function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))`.
n must count only the values that aren't missing. `length(x)` counts the NAs too; `sum(!is.na(x))` doesn't.
Then `se_pre <- se_mean(survey$anxiety_pre)` and the same for `anxiety_post`.

dialog.label: Options
dialog.value: Mean, S.E. mean, Std. deviation, Minimum, Maximum

spss.syntax:
DESCRIPTIVES VARIABLES=anxiety_pre anxiety_post
  /STATISTICS=MEAN SEMEAN STDDEV MIN MAX.
